content.title: Convert JPG to HEIC Online
content.p1: Our free JPG to HEIC converter allows you to transform standard JPEG images into the modern High Efficiency Image Container (HEIC) format used by Apple devices.
content.p2: HEIC files offer superior compression, maintaining high image quality at roughly half the file size of an equivalent JPEG. This tool is perfect for optimizing storage on iOS devices and Mac computers.

compression.title: Better Compression
compression.desc: HEIC files are up to 50% smaller than JPEGs with similar visual quality.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: HEIC saves significant storage space without sacrificing quality, which is ideal for archiving photos or using on Apple ecosystems.
faq.a2: Windows 10 and 11 support HEIC, but you may need to install the free HEIF Image Extensions from the Microsoft Store.
